# 3D assets for Sprout (decision 108)

All CC0 1.0 (public domain); crediting isn't required, but we credit anyway. They come from the
@netforge/asset-library-files npm package (0.2.0), which keeps optimised (meshopt) copies and records each
asset's source page; its NOTICE is in NOTICE-netforge.txt and the CC0 legal code in CC0-1.0.txt.

- models/adventurer.glb, hooded_adventurer.glb, monarch.glb, astronaut.glb, soldier.glb, grenade.glb, crate.glb, barrels.glb, generator.glb, generator_large.glb, turret.glb, chest.glb, robot_gunner.glb, worker.glb, mech.glb, delivery_van.glb, satellite_dish.glb, column.glb, tree_pine.glb, tree_oak.glb, tree_pine_tall.glb, bush.glb, rock_large.glb:
  Quaternius (https://quaternius.com), CC0
- models/blaster_g.glb, blaster_e.glb: Kenney, Blaster Kit 2.1 (https://kenney.nl/assets/blaster-kit), CC0
- textures/concrete.png, plate.png, metal.png, wall.png: Screaming Brain Studios (OpenGameArt), CC0
- textures/grass.png, dirt.png, gravel.png, stone.png, wood.png, bark.png: Screaming Brain Studios (OpenGameArt texture packs),
  CC0, the 128 px editions in the same package's PS1 style
- sfx/shoot.ogg, hit.ogg, hurt.ogg, impact.ogg, kill.ogg: from the same package's sound set, CC0

three.js (vendor/three) is MIT licensed; its LICENSE is in vendor/three.
